fetch_log.details: STITCH_TOKEN was not set in the environment; fetch not attempted. To record the design reference, set STITCH_TOKEN and run the curl command in fetch_instructions from the repository root.

Automated test/e2e run did not include the Stitch screen JSON (docs/evidence/screen-45ac4478.json) or the thumbnail. The PR must either commit the fetched JSON and thumbnail or explicitly document why fetching was not possible (e.g., missing STITCH_TOKEN or corporate network restrictions).

fetch_instructions.description: If you have a valid STITCH_TOKEN in your environment, run the curl commands below from the repository root to fetch the Stitch screen JSON and thumbnail into docs/evidence/. After fetching, commit docs/evidence/screen-45ac4478.json and docs/evidence/screen-45ac4478-thumbnail.png and any referenced assets (download to src/assets/) before requesting final review.
fetch_instructions.notes: Run the two commands above from the repository root. If corporate networking blocks the request or STITCH_TOKEN cannot be provided in CI, run locally where STITCH_TOKEN is available and copy the resulting files into docs/evidence/. After committing the files, re-run the test/e2e workflow so screenshots and the fetch artifact are present in test output.

asset_instructions: If the fetched JSON references remote assets (images, fonts), download each asset to src/assets/ (create the directory if missing) and update src/pages/LandingBarebones.jsx to reference the local copies. Example: curl -L "<asset_url>" -o src/assets/<filename> && git add src/assets/<filename>
evidence_required: src/assets/<downloaded assets referenced by the JSON>

design_fetch_validation.how_to_reproduce: From repository root: export STITCH_TOKEN=your_token_here && curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $STITCH_TOKEN" "https://api.stitch.google/v1/projects/13629074018280446337/screens/45ac4478a1b7455f861d7377f92105e6" > docs/evidence/screen-45ac4478.json && curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $STITCH_TOKEN" "https://api.stitch.google/v1/projects/13629074018280446337/screens/45ac4478a1b7455f861d7377f92105e6/thumbnail" -o docs/evidence/screen-45ac4478-thumbnail.png

test_evidence_inclusion.required_action: Commit the fetched JSON and thumbnail and re-run tests. After doing so, ensure docs/evidence/test-summary.txt contains the npm test and e2e output and that screenshots are saved at docs/evidence/screenshot-1024x768.png and docs/evidence/screenshot-375x812.png.
